range_diff.empty.hint: Neither version has commits of its own.
range_diff.empty.title: No commits to compare

range_diff.pane.added: Only the new version has this commit.
range_diff.pane.removed: Only the old version has this commit: it was dropped, squashed or changed past recognition.
range_diff.pane.same: Both versions of this commit make the same change.
range_diff.pane.select: Select a commit to see what changed between its two versions.

range_diff.title: Range-diff
range_diff.too_many: Too many commits to compare: at most {max} a side (the old version has {old}, the new one {new}).
